children: OXFORD INDUSTRIES INC reported results for the 2026 quarter showing slightly lower revenue but materially higher earnings versus the prior-year quarter, driven by margin improvements and one-time tariff benefits. Net sales were $394.38M, net income was $48.97M and diluted EPS was $3.25.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue and profitability: Net sales were modestly down year over year (about (1–2%)), while gross margin and EBITDA improved materially, aided by tariff refunds and higher initial markups.
Channel mix: Direct-to-consumer remained roughly 82% of sales; growth in food & beverage and e-commerce partially offset weaker wholesale performance.

Brand performance: Tommy Bahama posted growth across retail, F&B and e-commerce; Lilly Pulitzer and Johnny Was experienced sales declines but delivered improved margins through pricing and sourcing actions.
Operations: Completed distribution center transition activities, opened or converted select retail and F&B locations, and continued rollout of SaaS implementations.
